transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Business Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Alex. My name is Maria Rodriguez. I'm calling to add a new mobile line to our corporate account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, Maria. I can certainly assist you with that. To access your account, I'll need to verify a few details for security. Could you please provide me with your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, of course. The customer ID is CUST-2006.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I'm pulling up CUST-2006 now. I see the account is for Beacon Consulting. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's us. Beacon Consulting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. And for the final verification step, can you please provide the 6-digit security PIN associated with the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Let me see... yes, it's 9-1-9-5-3-4.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Let me just validate that. One moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, the PIN is confirmed. Thank you for verifying your information, Maria. I see you currently have our Enterprise SIP Trunking service. So, you're looking to add a mobile line today. Is that for a new employee?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. We have a new project manager starting, and we need to get him set up with a company phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's great. We can definitely get that set up for you. Are you just looking to add the line of service, or will you need a new device as well?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: We'll need a new device as well. He needs something reliable. I was thinking about one of the new iPhones.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent choice. Let's start with the service plan first, and then we can pick out the perfect phone. For our business accounts, we have a couple of great unlimited options. Do you know what kind of usage to expect? Heavy data, hotspot needs?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: He'll be traveling between client sites, so definitely heavy data usage. And yes, he'll need to use the phone as a hotspot for his laptop quite often.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In that case, I would highly recommend our Cymbal Business Unlimited Plus plan. It includes unlimited premium data that doesn't slow down, and it comes with 60 gigabytes of high-speed mobile hotspot data per month. Our standard plan only has 15.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, 60 gigabytes of hotspot sounds much better. What's the price difference between the two plans?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: With your existing business account, the standard Business Unlimited plan is $65 per month per line. The Business Unlimited Plus plan is $75 per month. So it's a $10 difference for the premium data and the extra hotspot capacity.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And that includes all taxes and fees?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's the base rate before the standard taxes and regulatory fees, which are typically a few dollars per line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's fine. For a key employee, the extra $10 is worth it for the reliability. Let's go with the Business Unlimited Plus plan.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A wise choice. I've selected the Cymbal Business Unlimited Plus plan for this new line. Now for the fun part, let's talk about the phone. You mentioned an iPhone. We have the new iPhone 15 series available.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes. What's the top model you have? The Pro, or Pro Max?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have both. The iPhone 15 Pro has a 6.1-inch display, and the Pro Max has a larger 6.7-inch display. They are identical otherwise in terms of camera and processing power. Do you have a preference?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The standard Pro size is probably best. He won't want something quite that large in his pocket. So the iPhone 15 Pro.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, iPhone 15 Pro. We have a few storage options. It starts at 128 gigabytes, and we also have 256, 512, and 1 terabyte models. For business use with lots of files and photos, I usually recommend at least 256.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I agree. 128 fills up too fast these days. Let's do the 256 gigabyte version.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. And do you have a color preference? The iPhone 15 Pro in 256 gigabytes is available in Natural Titanium, Blue Titanium, White Titanium, and Black Titanium.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm, let's go with something professional. The Black Titanium sounds good.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. So that's one iPhone 15 Pro, 256 gigabytes, in Black Titanium. Now, are you purchasing the device outright today, or would you like to finance it on your monthly bill?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'd like to finance it. What are the options for that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, let me pull up the financing details for your account. One moment please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, thank you for your patience. So, the full retail price for that device is $1099. We can finance that over 36 months with 0% interest for qualified business accounts, which yours is. There's no down payment required.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So it would be added to my monthly bill? How much would the monthly payment be?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct. Let's see... $1099 divided by 36 months comes out to $30.53 per month for the device.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: $30.53 a month for 36 months. That works perfectly for our budget.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. So I have the line and the device ready in my cart. Is there anything else you wanted to add, like a case or insurance?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, insurance is a good idea. What are the options for that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We offer Cymbal Protect, our device protection plan. It covers loss, theft, accidental damage, and out-of-warranty malfunctions. For a high-end device like the iPhone 15 Pro, it's $17 per month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Seventeen dollars a month... and what's the deductible if we need to use it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The deductible for a screen repair is just $29. For a full device replacement due to loss, theft, or damage beyond repair, it's $249.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's reasonable. Yes, please add the Cymbal Protect plan as well. Better safe than sorry.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent decision. I've added Cymbal Protect to the order. So, let's do a quick recap before we finalize everything.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, sounds good.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We are adding one new mobile line with the Cymbal Business Unlimited Plus plan at $75 per month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We are financing one Apple iPhone 15 Pro, 256 gigabytes, in Black Titanium. The monthly installment will be $30.53 for 36 months.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And we are adding the Cymbal Protect insurance for $17 per month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, the total new monthly recurring charge for this line, before taxes and fees, will be $75 for the plan, plus $30.53 for the phone, plus $17 for insurance... which comes to $122.53.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, $122.53 per month. That all looks correct to me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. There is also a one-time activation fee of $35 that will appear on your next bill. However, as a thank you for being a valued Cymbal Telecom business partner, I'm going to go ahead and waive that fee for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, really? Thank you, Alex! I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. I've added a credit to the account to offset that charge. Now, I just need a little more information to complete the order. What is the name of the employee this line will be assigned to?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: His name is David Chen.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, David Chen. And what is the shipping address for the new phone and SIM card? Is it the same as your business address on file?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please ship it to our main office. The address you have for Beacon Consulting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. I'll just confirm that address with you. Is it 123 Corporate Plaza, Suite 400, Anytown, USA, 12345?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is the correct address.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. We offer free 2-day shipping. I am now processing the order. This will just take a minute or two on my end. Please stay on the line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem, I'll wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, Maria, thank you so much for your patience. The order has been successfully submitted.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great! So what happens next?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will receive an email confirmation with all the order details within the next hour. I can give you the order number now for your records if you'd like.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please. Let me grab a pen.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The order number is 8-6-7-5-3-0-9-B-C. As in Beacon Consulting.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Got it. 8675309BC. And you said it's 2-day shipping?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct. You should receive the device and SIM card within two business days. The tracking information will be in the confirmation email.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. When we get the phone, is there anything special we need to do to activate it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's a very simple process. The SIM card will already be installed in the new iPhone. You just need to power it on and follow the on-screen instructions. It will automatically activate on the Cymbal Telecom network.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds easy enough.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It is. Now, I do want to give you a heads-up about your next bill, just so there are no surprises.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because you're adding this line in the middle of your billing cycle, your next invoice will include prorated charges. This means you'll see a charge for the portion of this month that the line is active, plus the full charge for the next month in advance. It only happens on the first bill.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right, that makes sense. So the first mobile bill will be a bit higher than the normal $122.53.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. After that first bill, it will normalize to the quoted monthly amount plus taxes. I just wanted to make sure you were aware.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you for the clear explanation. I understand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. And just to confirm, the confirmation email should be sent to the email address we have on file, which is maria.rodriguez@beaconconsulting.com. Is that still the best email for you?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that is my correct email address.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. I have placed all the notes from our conversation on the account and linked them to the new order.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. This was much easier than I expected.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm so glad to hear that! We try to make it as seamless as possible for our business customers.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, you succeeded today. Alex, you've been very helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure, Maria. Is there anything else at all I can assist you with today? Any other questions about your account or services?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I think that's everything for now. You've covered all my questions.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright. Well, thank you again for your business. We truly value our partnership with Beacon Consulting.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, Alex.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You'll receive a short, one-question survey via text message after this call. We'd appreciate your feedback on the service I provided today.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'll be sure to give you top marks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, I appreciate that. Have a wonderful rest of your day, Maria.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, wait, Alex, are you still there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, Maria, I'm still here. Is everything alright?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sorry, one last question just popped into my head. Does the unlimited plan include any international calling? David may need to call some vendors in Canada.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is an excellent question, and I'm glad you asked. Yes, the Cymbal Business Unlimited Plus plan includes unlimited calling, texting, and data within and between the US, Canada, and Mexico. So calls to Canada are included at no extra charge.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, that's fantastic! I was expecting to have to add a package for that. That's great news.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, it's one of the best features of that plan. It also includes unlimited texting to over 200 countries worldwide.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow. Okay, that's even better. This plan is perfect for our needs.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm happy to hear that. It really is a comprehensive solution for business users.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that was my last question, for real this time. Thank you for clarifying.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not a problem at all, Maria. That's what I'm here for. I've added a note to the account about your question on Canada roaming just for future reference.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You're very thorough.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I try to be! It helps ensure we have all the details covered for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, I appreciate it. Thanks again for everything.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure. Was there anything else?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Nope, that's it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay then. Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. Have a great afternoon.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Bye now.
